text:
jules: Customer Amy (amy-cust) just asked to get their Sable-9B model onto Redwood Dedicated. They need int8 quant to hit cost targets. Requesting triage: perf/quality checks, tokenization sanity, and rollout plan. Target SLA: p95 < 180ms for 8k context for chat use. Customer says latency critical. Here are initial details: model format: HF .bin, tokenizer: sentencepiece v0.1, vocab 50k, FP16 baseline: 9B, PEFT: none, sample workload: system+user prompts avg length 120 tokens. Priority: high (customer pilot next week).

amy-cust: adding customer note: can share eval dataset privately (500 prompts) if we sign NDA. Primary failure mode they care about is hallucination on code snippets and instruction-following drift.

liz: ack, assigning @vikram to lead quant triage. Will need calibration data + sample outputs. @amy-cust can you drop model link and tokenizer files? :thumbsup:

vikram: on it. Quick ask: do we have a baseline FP16 run with p95/throughput numbers? If not I can spin one on the dev A100. Also suspect tokenizer mismatch -> please include sentencepiece model file.

jules: no baseline yet. @liz can we give them a dedicated slot tomorrow morning? If not, run smoke on a devbox and escalate.

sam: I can carve out a dev A100 (80GB) for a 2-3h smoke window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Tentative booking in infra calendar. model-bot: created ticket ML-4521 for Sable-9B onboarding.

model-bot: Ticket ML-4521 created: assignee=vikram, priority=high, labels=[quant,customer-onboard]

vikram: proposed plan:
1) run fp16 smoke (latency & p95 profiling)
2) run PTQ with 128 calibration batches
3) run eval set scoring (BLEU/ROUGE + custom hallucination metric)
4) compare logits and run regression checks vs FP16
5) if regression >1% on hallucination metric -> try per-channel quant or GPTQ-4bit

toni: add checks: token alignment diff >0.5% triggers tokenizer repro step. watch KV-cache token growth and memory accounting.

liz: actionable for customer: (1) share model artifacts + tokenizer, (2) share eval set or ok for us to use synthetic, (3) sign NDA, (4) provide 10 "must-pass" prompts. That lets us set gating metrics for canary.

amy-cust: sharing link via DM now. NDA in progress. Sending 10 must-pass prompts and a short regression checklist.

vikram: starting fp16 smoke now. Command used:
```bash
python tools/smoke_run.py --model ./sable9b --dtype fp16 --batch 1 --seq 1024
```
Initial p95 ~210ms on A100 (single stream) — a bit over the customer target.

sam: try enabling KV cache + prefill batching and disable micro-batching. Those configs often cut p95 significantly for single-stream chat.

vikram: re-ran with `--kv-cache-enabled --prefill-batching 1` and p95 dropped to ~165ms. PTQ run queued. Starting PTQ (128 calib batches):
```bash
python tools/ptq.py --model ./sable9b --calib_batches 128 --out ./sable9b-int8
```

jules: note: if PTQ regresses beyond +1% on hallucination metric, we'll escalate to per-channel PTQ or GPTQ 4-bit. Also ensure we capture logits diffs and sample outputs for the 10 must-pass prompts.

vikram: PTQ finished. Quick metrics: hallucination metric delta = +0.9% (within threshold). Tokenizer mismatch 0.2% — low but we'll record. Will run full eval and push artifacts to ML-4521.

liz: perfect. Once eval artifacts are in ML-4521 tag me. Plan rollout: canary 10% traffic x24h, automatic rollback if quality regression >1.5% or p95 > 200ms.

amy-cust: appreciate the quick turnaround. Happy to pilot the canary. ETA for canary start?

vikram: if no blockers, canary ready tomorrow 09:30 PT after morning sanity. I'll post final checklist in ML-4521.

jules: awesome, thanks team. :rocket:
